title: 370kW PV + Storage Reference Project in Nigeria
summary: A 370kW solar PV reference project in Nigeria, with battery storage.
imageCaption: Dawnice Energy deployment in Nigeria — field installation with the Dawnice Energy team.
challenge: Distributed PV in Nigeria has to be planned around weak grid availability and around the load the site cannot afford to lose.
solution: A 370kW PV array with battery storage, matching PV input, PCS and backup target to the site's load profile.
